chapter: Return to Basie and leaving in 1948
title: Dannie Barker in Omaha and rejoining Basie in 1946
summary: Jones tells how he introduced Dannie Barker to old circus musicians and then rejoined Basie in spring 1946.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Dannie Barker, the guitar with us player?

That's right and he left the band then. He stayed in Omaha with me for 3 days in my home and I got him a lot of literature and I introduced him to several of the old pioneers and I sent him down to Scott Joplin's home. There was a trumpet player that had lived round in that area that died. He had cancer of the lip, because. I remember seeing him coming out of P. G. Lowry and Abe Wright days. These are great guys that played on the circus. Dannie had a lot of literature. That's the reason he knows what he's talking about in New Orleans, you see, coming up from New Orleans and he got authentic material. Then after that I said, "Well, I'll try to go back with Basie's band." I rejoined them -
When did you rejoin the band?
Ah, February, March, about the first week in April, somewhere like that in 1946. It was a little hazy for me because I had to find myself after spending all
that time in the Army, you see, and I had to rewind.
